evidence: Modifies shared cryptographic primitives in src/crypto/chacha20* to add SIMD vectorization.
rationale: Implements vectorized ChaCha20 to achieve a 2x to 3x throughput improvement across x86-64 and ARM64 architectures. ChaCha20 encryption accounts for up to 30% of the network thread's CPU time during BIP324 v2 transport, making this a substantial performance optimization for node operators experiencing peer relay and IBD bottlenecks.
